prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview Your Custom Desktop Companion", "Inspect your pet's 3D desktop lighting and animation details before issuing your official certificate.", "Confirm & Continue", "Rotate View"]
1: ["Verifying Cloud Save Data", "We are syncing your account records to guarantee your pet profiles and items are safely preserved.", "Continue to Setup", "Cloud Save Active"]
2: ["Building Your Desktop Companion", "Preparing screen overlay graphics and loading your pet's behavioral animations.", "Verifying Desktop Overlay Permissions", "Initializing Graphics Engine"]
3: ["Master Your Desktop Controls", "Try key shortcuts now to easily summon, hide, or talk to your pet anytime.", "Finish Setup", "Shortcut Keys: Alt+P (Show/Hide) | Alt+T (Talk)"]
4: ["This adoption certificate is permanently bound to your account and backed up to the cloud."]
5: ["Choose Your Companion", "Compare personality traits and desktop behaviors side by side."]
6: ["Checking display resolution and multi-monitor compatibility..."]
7: ["Includes Bonus Starter Hat & Toy"]
8: ["Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to access controls or hide your pet."]
9: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "Log in to seamlessly access your existing desktop pets, custom skins, and cloud progress."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bonus items or free extras
